Erin: quick debrief from Pinecrest onboarding call — several feature asks + one renewal flag. Attaching raw notes.
Sam: can you paste the top 3 asks here so we can triage?
Erin: sure — top 3: 1) embeddings mismatch for product search (results return vendor names not SKUs) 2) per-route billing/limits in docs are unclear (customer thought quota = global) 3) want team-level quotas + admin UI to set them. Also they called out onboarding docs: `per-route` example uses old param name.
Tony: for #1 can you share a sample query + response? we might be able to repro with current model.
Erin: pasted snippet below and link to session transcript: https://app.redwood/meetings/pc-2026-04-12/transcript 
Erin: ```
query: "find sku for blue widget"
response: "Blue Widget by AcmeCo" (no SKU returned)
```
Natalie: noted. This customer is on a quarterly renewal — the account lead said if search reliability doesn't improve they may pause expansion. marking as renewal risk FYI.
Sam: thanks — tagging for product priority. @Tony can you estimate quick triage: a) reproduce + b) fix ETA?
Tony: I'll repro today. if it's a prompt / pre-processing bug we can patch in a week; if it's model behavior might be longer. will update.
Erin: customer also asked for UX copy change in docs — small ask we can push via docs site.
Sam: ok — action items: 1) Tony to triage embeddings (owner: Tony) 2) Docs edit (owner: Sam) 3) Add team-quotas request to feature backlog (owner: Erin).
Erin: I created a short ticket and uploaded call notes: https://app.redwood/feedback/FEED-8421 — please add estimates and label `onboarding-risk` / `search` as applicable.
feedback-bot: Feedback FEED-8421 added to backlog and linked to customer Pinecrest. Priority: P2.
Natalie: I'll follow up with Pinecrest CSM to surface interim mitigation (workaround: instruct them to include SKU hints in prompt) and capture any additional win conditions.
Sam: agree — let's get a canary fix for docs & a triage update by EOD tomorrow.
Tony: updating FEED-8421 with initial repro steps. will post logs here once I run tests.
Erin: thanks team :thumbsup: — I'll schedule a 15m sync with Pinecrest + CS lead if we have actionable next steps after Tony's repro.
